title: Ignite Networking Night 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 54 attendees for this Networking Night, in line with turnout at our previous Networking Night events.
We can deliver this Networking Night efficiently within INR 10,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
